consequence: Extreme heat events become more frequent
description: Central focal change for the heat consequence wheel.
Heat increases electricity demand and cooling dependence.
Heat increases risk for outdoor workers and labor-intensive services.
Higher cooling demand increases bills and household burden.
Peak load increases grid stress and outage risk.
Exposure produces illness and emergency response pressure.
Energy costs increase debt and insecurity.
Heat emergencies strain health systems and staffing.
Repeated failures undermine trust and increase pressure for adaptation.

consequence: Public AI systems scale before accountability capacity matures
description: Central focal change for public AI consequence wheel.
AI outputs affect eligibility triage or case review.

consequence: Procurement and audit capacity are exposed as weak
description: Public systems lack mature governance infrastructure.
Automated decisions require clear appeal and review systems.

consequence: Worker discretion and accountability become unclear
description: Workers may be responsible for decisions shaped by opaque systems.

consequence: Public trust declines after visible AI harms
description: Harms reduce trust in public service institutions.

consequence: Civil-rights litigation and oversight pressure rise
description: Accountability failures trigger legal and policy responses.

consequence: Digital governance standards become politically urgent
description: Public pressure creates policy window for standards.
